{{Top|leg}}
'''Pier Green''' was a docking area of the city [[Bartyn's Landing]] in [[Lamaredd/Legends|Lamaredd]]. It was close to [[Center Sphere District]] and was used by wealthy residents to dock their luxury boats, under the watchful eye of official dockmasters.

==History==
The fishing city of [[Bartyn's Landing]] was built around five hundred years before the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|Battle of Naboo]] using a [[Hoersch-Kessel Drive, Inc./Legends|Hoersch-Kessel]] [[LH-3010 capital freighter]] as a basis. The founder used his mining droids to place the three-kilometer ship in the shore of a stretch, with the bow in the water. He thus created a dock for his town.<ref name="BL">{{GamerCite|7|Bartyn's Landing (article)}}</ref>

Eventually, the dock would be divided in several smaller docks, with Pier Green becoming one of them. Pier Green was commonly the place where rich citizens parked their luxury boats.<ref name="R">{{GamerCite|7|Reckonings}}</ref> Meanwhile, fishermen preferred to go to [[The Three Jetties]].<ref name="BL" />

In [[29 BBY/Legends|29 BBY]], the yacht ''[[Tria Blue]]'', belonging to Bartyn's descendant and successor [[Guther Bartyn]], was harbored in Pier Green, under dockmaster [[Howe Walwahd]] and with special security agents onboard. Two native [[Menahuun]] stowawayed on the ship, killed the watchers and prepared to sabotage the ship.<ref name="R" />
